F-moose-backcountry-0025.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed gravel road

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2009 (17 years old), 70 m SE: browse.
Moose winter range u-4-006 unit 6818 (official), 200 m E. Counts from November.

flags.t: Spot is inside a Motor Vehicle Closed Area: Alexander Creek. Closed Year Round. Synopsis map 1-38/24.

CWD (Chronic Wasting Disease) Management Zone, MU 4-23: every deer, elk and moose taken here must have its head sampled at a CWD freezer before you leave the zone (www.gov.bc.ca/CWDdropoff). Brain and spinal column (vertebrae, not the tail) may not leave the zone: leave them at the kill site or a landfill in it (synopsis pages 15, 36, 37, 99%).

Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

plan: Drive: from Cranbrook, about 112 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.77115, -114.64667, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 7.5 km W, on Cp179. Climb about 92 m, about 160 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 200 m E of the spot at 1,500 m (49.76286, -114.71922). Water: Alexander Creek 110 m E (estimate).
Hunt: moose, Sept, Oct (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).

Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-23, Region 4. CWD zone: deer, elk and moose heads go to a CWD freezer; brain and spine stay in the zone. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-04, private land 2026-09-26, closures 2026-10-03.
